record.body:
## Description

R4: A CI action or workflow runs verdict and produces a signed attestation on a fixture repository.

## Approach

1. Add .github/workflows/affidavit-verdict.yml (or actions/) that checks out a fixture path, runs aff verdict, emits a signed attestation, and verifies it.
2. Document required secrets/allowlist for the fixture key.
3. A pytest can assert the workflow file exists and references aff attest/verdict emit path.
4. Do not change attestation core modules (attest-core owns those).

payload.title: Ship CI workflow for signed verdict
